name: Buddy
subtitle: Buddy, your AI helper in the Dynamic Island

apps.name: Buddy
apps.subtitle: Ask anything from the Dynamic Island
apps.localizedDescription: Buddy lives in your Dynamic Island. Tap it to ask, or double-tap the back of your iPhone to send a screenshot - the answer appears right in the island while you stay in your app. Free brain, no account.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Buddy for Mac is no longer English-only. Menu bar, Voice language: hold-to-talk listens in Indonesian, Chinese (Taiwan or Mainland), Cantonese, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Thai, Vietnamese, Hindi, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese or English.
• On the Mac, Buddy answers in the language you asked in and reads the answer with a Mac voice for that language. On a test Mac, Apple's older language detector read Indonesian as Turkish; Buddy now uses the newer recogniser and your voice language as a hint.
• On the Mac, menu items a non-English answer puts on the screen's top edge now snap to the matching text on screen, the Mac form of the 1.3.1 Windows fix.
• Windows: the Focus tab's summary uses the whole width of the tab and says 1/5 stars instead of 1 stars.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Buddy looks at your latest screenshot only when you ask about it.
